Da Nang, widely known as the most livable city in Vietnam, is an ideal destination for the 2026 holiday season. From the charming My Khe Beach and the magical Ba Na Hills to the sacred Marble Mountains and the ancient town of Hoi An, this coastal city offers a perfect blend of nature, culture, and modern attractions. This article highlights must-visit destinations and unique experiences to help travelers enjoy a memorable early-year vacation in Da Nang.

Da Nang has long been a favorite destination for both domestic and international visitors. Especially during the New Year holiday, it becomes an ideal place to explore thanks to its pleasant climate, diverse attractions, and vibrant atmosphere. From pristine beaches and world-class entertainment complexes to spiritual landmarks and cultural heritage sites, Da Nang promises unforgettable experiences for your 2026 getaway.

1. My Khe Beach – Where Happiness Begins

My Khe Beach, with its soft white sand stretching along the coastline and crystal-clear blue water, is not only one of the most beautiful beaches in the world as recognized by Forbes, but also a symbol of Da Nang tourism. Visiting My Khe during the New Year holiday allows travelers to enjoy fresh air and a peaceful atmosphere, far from the hustle and bustle of big cities.

Although it is not peak beach season, the weather remains pleasant with gentle sunshine, making it ideal for outdoor activities such as beach walks, light sports, or simply relaxing by the sea. Visitors can also enjoy fresh seafood at seaside restaurants, from casual local eateries to upscale dining venues. Early mornings at My Khe are especially beautiful, offering stunning sunrise views and perfect photo opportunities.

2. Ba Na Hills – A Fairytale Land Above The Clouds

Ba Na Hills, often referred to as “Heaven on Earth,” is a French-style resort complex located at an altitude of 1,489 meters above sea level. The world-record cable car system offers breathtaking views as it passes through clouds and lush forests.

During the New Year holiday, visitors can experience four seasons in one day, from cool mornings to chilly evenings. Highlights include the iconic Golden Bridge, the charming French Village, Le Jardin d’Amour flower gardens, the historic Debay Wine Cellar, and Linh Ung Pagoda. Fantasy Park offers hundreds of indoor games suitable for all ages. Booking tickets in advance is recommended during holiday periods.

3. Marble Mountains – A Legend Of Stone And Spirituality

The Marble Mountains, also known as Ngu Hanh Son, consist of five limestone hills representing the five elements. Located about eight kilometers from the city center, this site is both a natural wonder and a spiritual center with ancient caves, pagodas, and panoramic viewpoints.

Visitors can explore famous caves such as Huyen Khong Cave and Am Phu Cave, as well as Tam Thai Pagoda. Nearby, the Non Nuoc Stone Carving Village showcases over 400 years of traditional craftsmanship, offering beautifully carved marble sculptures and souvenirs.

4. Linh Ung Pagoda – A Sacred Symbol By The Sea

Located on the Son Tra Peninsula, Linh Ung Pagoda is home to the majestic 67-meter-tall Lady Buddha statue facing the sea. The pagoda offers a peaceful atmosphere, stunning coastal views, and a strong sense of spiritual tranquility.

It is an ideal place to pray for peace, admire Buddhist architecture, and enjoy panoramic views of Da Nang city and My Khe Beach. Visiting in the late afternoon allows travelers to witness a breathtaking sunset.

5. Asia Park – Asian-Standard Entertainment Park

Asia Park is a large entertainment complex showcasing the cultures of eleven Asian countries. It features thrilling rides, family-friendly attractions, cultural architecture, and Sun Wheel, one of the world’s tallest Ferris wheels.

The park is perfect for families and groups, offering cultural performances, diverse dining options, and exciting nighttime views of Da Nang.

6. Da Nang’s Iconic Bridges – Architectural Masterpieces

Known as the “City of Bridges,” Da Nang boasts unique architectural landmarks such as the Dragon Bridge, Han River Swing Bridge, Tran Thi Ly Bridge, and Thuan Phuoc Bridge.

Visitors can enjoy a Han River cruise at night to admire the illuminated skyline and watch the Dragon Bridge breathe fire and water on weekend evenings. The Love Bridge nearby is a popular romantic spot for couples.

7. Hai Van Pass – The World’s Most Scenic Coastal Road

Hai Van Pass, known as “The First Magnificent Pass Under Heaven,” is one of the most beautiful coastal mountain roads in the world. From its peak, travelers can enjoy panoramic views of Da Nang city, Lang Co Bay, and the surrounding mountains.

The cool climate and misty scenery during early-year months create a magical atmosphere, making it a favorite destination for adventure lovers and photographers.

8. Hoi An Ancient Town – A UNESCO World Heritage Site

Located about 30 kilometers from Da Nang, Hoi An Ancient Town is famous for its preserved architecture, lantern-lit streets, and rich cultural heritage. Walking through its narrow alleys, visiting ancient houses, Japanese Covered Bridge, and traditional assembly halls offers a glimpse into Vietnam’s trading past.

At night, the town glows with colorful lanterns and floating candle lights along the Hoai River. Local specialties such as Cao Lau, Mi Quang, and traditional pastries are must-try experiences.

9. Than Tai Hot Spring Park – Relaxation In Nature

Than Tai Hot Spring Park is a perfect place to unwind after days of sightseeing. Located in Hoa Vang District, this wellness destination offers natural hot mineral baths, mud baths, herbal baths, and Japanese-style onsen experiences.

Surrounded by mountains and greenery, it combines relaxation, health care, and entertainment, making it ideal for families and couples.

10. Cu Lao Cham – A Pristine Island Paradise

Cu Lao Cham, a UNESCO-recognized World Biosphere Reserve, is located about 15 kilometers off the coast of Hoi An. The island is known for its clear waters, diverse marine life, and unspoiled natural beauty.

Visitors can snorkel to explore coral reefs, relax on secluded beaches, visit ancient wells and temples, and enjoy freshly caught seafood. Environmental protection is strongly emphasized, creating a peaceful and eco-friendly travel experience.

Travel Tips For Da Nang New Year Holiday 2026

  • Plan and book flights, hotels, and tours early due to peak travel demand.

  • Consider guided tours for convenience and time efficiency.

  • Rent a motorbike or use taxis for flexible transportation.

  • Prepare light jackets for cooler evenings, especially in mountainous areas.

Da Nang is more than just a destination it is a complete travel experience where nature, culture, and modern life come together harmoniously. With these suggestions, your New Year holiday in 2026 promises to be truly memorable
